tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid tho yig bzhugs so// na mo lo ki shwa ra ya/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid gnyan tshem bu pa'i lugs kyi khrid kyi tho la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang / gdams pa dngos gnyis/ dang po ni grub thob tshem bu pa/ 'khrungs yul shab stod pa/ gdung rus gnyan/ mtshan dar ma 'od/ na bza' las mtshan du grags pa tshem bu pa'o/ /de nas bzung ste bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus skabs su gang bab bshad/ gnyis pa gdams pa dngos la/ khrid bya'i gzhi ngos bzung ba/ khrid byed kyi thabs bstan pa/ de ltar khrid pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po sgrub pa po rang gi sems gsal stong zung 'jug go /'di rgyas par gzhi'i skabs kyi chos skad rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba ltar skabs su gang bab bsnyad/ gnyis pa 'khrid byed kyi thabs la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong ba dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa rnams spyi 'gro ltar 'chad pa'am/ slob ma rnams la nges 'byung gi bsam pa brtan po yod na ma bshad kyang chad skyon med/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ yig brgya/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor maṇḍal dang bcas pa 'khrid dmigs phog nas/ rtags thon thon bar du bsgom/ dngos gzhi yongs rdzogs ni rnal 'byor bla med kyi dbang thob pa la 'bogs/ ma thob pa rnams la spyan ras gzigs bsgom lung tsam dang yi ge drug pa'i bzlas lung tsam dang 'pho lung tsam 'bogs so/ /'di ni dbang thob pa'i lugs su byas nas bshad pa na/ dngos gzhi la rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor/ rjes spyod rnal 'byor drug gi nyams len no/ /dang po la bskyed rim dang / de la sems 'dzin pa'i man ngag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyas pa la/ skyabs 'gro nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bar/ bsdu na/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ yig brgya gsum sngon du btang nas tshad med bzhi bsgom pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /ye shes kyis tshogs ni gnas lugs kyi don bsgom zhing / swa bha wa sogs kyi sngags brjod pa'o/ /dngos gzhi ni/ mngon byang lnga'am/ skad cig gis spyan ras gzigs bsgoms/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs sam/ bsdu na ma byung yang skyon med/ spro bsdu drug sogs bya/ sems 'dzin ni lha'i nga rgyal dang / rnam pa spyi dang bye brag la sems 'dzin pa sogs 'dra/ bzlas pa'i tshe rang kun 'dus rnam gnyis dang / snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du gsal ba las ma ṇi padme'i sgra grags stong rang bzhin med pa sgrog par bsam ste ma ṇi bgrang / de'ang kun 'dus rnam gnyis kyi go rgyu ni/ rang nyid thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i sku lus kyi nang thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas til gyi gang bu ltar gang bar bsam pa yi dam kun 'dus/ spyi bor bla ma 'od dpag med chos 'brel yod tshad kyi bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pas til gyi gang bu ltar bsam pa bla ma kun 'dus so/ /rdzogs rim ni rags pa rtsa gsum gsal btab rdor bzlas sogs dang / phra ba gnas lugs skye ba med pa'i don bsgom pa'o/ /rjes thob rnal 'byor drug gi nyams len ni zas gos gnas khang gnyis/ 'pho ba/ bar do rnams/ de ltar sngon 'gro'i dngos gzhi rjes kyi dmigs rkang thams cad nyams su len tshul ni/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dngos gzhi rang rang gi dmigs pa/ rjes bsdo ba smon lam dran shes kyi rgyun bstan pa'i skya bar du tshud par bya zhing / dmigs pa snga ma rnams la nyams ma skyes par phyi mar mi spo/ tshe 'di'i snyan grags sogs dang ma 'dres par bya/ nyams rtogs gang skyes kyang gzhan gyi ma tshor bar bya/ rang gi nyams su len rgyu'i chos dang bla ma la glo snying brang gsum hril gyis gtad/

rnam grangs mang po'i rtsom pa mi bya/ nyon mongs gang skyes kyang de ma thag 'bur 'joms bya/ gzhan gyi skyon la mi bsam ste thams cad lhar bsgom pa yin pas so/ /gang la'ang rtag 'dzin spangs te thams cad mi rtag cing rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu yin pas so/ /rab tu byung ba yin na rtag tu dman cha bzung nas thams cad gong du bkur dgos te dge sbyong gi chos bzhi khas blangs pas so/ /'di phyi bar do'i 'dun ma thams cad da lta'i rang sems skad cig ma 'di'i steng du thag gcad dgos te gzhan du le len bda' sa med pas so/ /spyi don gsum pa 'bras bu ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /sngon tshe grub pa'i dbang phyug tshem bu pas/ /'jig rten dpal 'byor snying po med gzigs nas/ /ri dwags lta bur mi med lung stong du/ /rtse gcig sgrub pas zab mo'i dngos grub brnyes/ /deng sang kun kyang stobs 'byor la dga' bas/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar rtswa bzhin 'dor/ /de phyir 'dis kyang phan pa'i go skabs ci/ /'on kyang bskul ngor rags bsdus tho 'di bkod/ /'dis mtshon dge tshogs kun gyi nus mthu yis/ /bdag cag tshe 'di myur du btang byas nas/ /'jig rten dbang po'i gnas mchog po ta lar/ /skyes nas brnag pa'i don de 'grub gyur cig /bkra shis/ sarba madga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid tho yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
